result.topic_en: Part of Riemann's natural-philosophy argument for an 'Erdseele' (soul of the earth) as a hypothesis explaining organic development, followed by the question of 'how' thinking relates to processes in ponderable matter and the hypothesis of a space-filling substance flowing into ponderable matter to explain gravitation, light and radiant heat.
